xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5465: Add skill packs to a running conversation (hot-load with /reload-plugins, resume fallback)

plan.title: Add skill packs to a running conversation (hot-load with /reload-plugins, resume fallback)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

references.label: PAN-5464 (companion: video packs and pack groups)

metadata.sizeJustification: One feature with one service and four thin callers (route, CLI, MCP tool, dashboard dialog) that the issue body requires together. Every caller only posts to the same route, and shipping the service without its entry points gives the operator nothing (operator rule: every capability needs an entry point from the conversation tab). The subsystem count is inflated because the lint counts each top-level doc file (features/*.mdx, configuration/mcp.mdx, docs/SKILL-PACKS.md, changelog.d) as its own subsystem. Pack groups are already split out to PAN-5497.

narratives.Problem: A conversation's pack skills are fixed at launch: the conversation row's skill map is set only when the conversation is created (PAN-4486). The operator wants to pull a pack into a conversation that is already running, without losing its context, and an agent should be able to load a pack into itself.
narratives.Proposal: Every Claude Code launch passes --plugin-dir, pointing at a fixed empty mount when no packs are on. A new apply service merges pack skills into the /clear chain head's skill map, then applies them: Claude Code conversations that run with --plugin-dir <their link> get a hot apply (rebuild the mount, re-point the link, deliver /reload-plugins, confirm by comparing skill counts before and after); Codex, native skills, launch-wired packs (deft, sageox, gstack-runtime, packs with MCP servers) and pre-change Claude sessions get needs-restart, or a resume apply with restart:true; stopped conversations get next-launch. A mid-turn conversation (always the case for the agent itself) gets queued: Claude Code runs the queued reload when the turn ends (spike 2). Three routes (GET/POST /api/conversations/:name/skills, POST /api/self/skills), pan skills add, the add_skills MCP tool and an Add skills… dialog in the conversation tab and header menus call it.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No pack groups anywhere (no `groups` field, no `--group`, no group checkboxes); a `groups` key gets 400 `Pack groups are not supported yet`. PAN-5497 adds them after PAN-5464 merges.
- No hot apply for native (non-pack) skills, Codex, or launch-wired packs (deft, sageox, gstack-runtime, packs with MCP servers); they return needs-restart.
- No skill changes for Pi, ohmypi, opencode or any harness other than Claude Code and Codex (409).
- No Add skills… item in ConversationRow.tsx (sidebar row menu).
- No removal of pack skills by clearing a value back to Inherit; only `off` writes false (add-only, D-1).
- No remote (Fly) or linked-machine (`@machine/name`) conversations.
- No keys-based delivery fallback for slash commands; the PRD checkpoint files a follow-up only with live evidence.
- No change to handleConversationMessage; the hot apply delivers through deliverAgentMessage.
- No raising of any file-size allowlist cap.
narratives.Verification: Live checks for the test/UAT role (AC-10 in the PRD), on the host's default terminal backend against the deployed build, with an isolated Playwright profile for the dashboard: (a) a new Claude Code conversation with no packs has `--plugin-dir <OVERDECK_HOME>/launch/<key>/skill-packs` in `ps -eo args=` and the link resolves to mounts/empty/plugins; (b) `pan skills add <conv> --pack mattpocock` on an idle Claude Code conversation prints the hot sentence and the agent then runs /mattpocock:grilling; (c) the same on a Codex conversation prints the needs-restart sentence; (d) an agent calling add_skills with packs [mattpocock] gets queued and invokes a mattpocock skill in its next turn; (e) the Add skills… dialog opens from the conversation header menu and shows the conversation's current pack values.

autoDecisions.summary: Pack groups are deferred to a new follow-up issue (PAN-5497); this issue ships packs and pack skills only.
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-5464's resolvePackGroup does not exist on main and PAN-5464 is still in planning; the PRD already allowed shipping without groups, and a conditional item would let two different diffs both look done.

autoDecisions.summary: add_skills without `conversation` posts to a new self route, POST /api/self/skills, that takes the conversation from the agent token.
autoDecisions.rationale: McpToolContext carries no caller identity; the self routes already resolve it from the token (self-caller.ts), and conversation tokens carry the operate scope.

autoDecisions.summary: A sixth outcome, `queued`, covers mid-turn conversations, and the self route never waits for a reload line.
autoDecisions.rationale: Spike 2 showed Claude Code queues a mid-turn /reload-plugins and runs it when the turn ends; an agent calling add_skills on itself is always mid-turn, so a blocking wait would always time out.

autoDecisions.summary: The hot-capable check reads `ps -eo pid=,ppid=,args=` for `--plugin-dir <exact link>` instead of /proc/<runtimePid>/cmdline.
autoDecisions.rationale: isAlive returns no runtimePid on Herdr, the default backend; the ps table is the existing precedent in conversation-runtime.ts and also works on macOS.

autoDecisions.summary: /reload-plugins is delivered with deliverAgentMessage after the message path's permission and input-target guards, not through handleConversationMessage.
autoDecisions.rationale: handleConversationMessage would retitle a default-titled conversation as /reload-plugins and start the PAN-1635 eaten-message watcher, which can redeliver a local command.

autoDecisions.summary: Resume apply uses stopConversationRuntime + handleConversationResume(resumeCause 'system'), and a conversation cannot restart itself through the self route (400).
autoDecisions.rationale: This is the native-compaction precedent; handleConversationStop marks the row ended and records a deliberate stop. A self-restart would kill the in-flight tool call.

autoDecisions.summary: Add skills… goes in the conversation tab menu and the conversation header menu, not the sidebar row menu.
autoDecisions.rationale: Those two cover the conversation surface the operator works from; ConversationRow.tsx is 920 lines and a third host adds risk without a new entry point.

autoDecisions.summary: The skill map is written to the /clear chain head, after conversationWriteRefusal and shutdownDrainingRefusal.
autoDecisions.rationale: The launch reads the map through getSupervisedConversationByTmuxSession, which returns the chain head; writing the named row could be silently ignored.

metadata.parallelSafeReason: New module plus an export keyword in conversation-runtime.ts; no other item touches either file, and it runs after launch-exclude.
metadata.acJustification: Six criteria: the pure helpers, both run paths, the prechecks and the delivery door are independent behaviors of one module.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-3 with D-3, D-4, D-5, D-7, D-8, D-9. New module exporting hotApplyPrecheck, hotApplyRun and the pure helpers hasPluginDirArg, launchWiredChange, readReloadLines; all I/O injected through HotApplyDeps. Add `export` to readProcessTable and ProcessTableRow in conversation-runtime.ts (no new lines). Precheck order: plugin-dir in ps args → launch-wired change against the live mount (selection resolved with conversationLayer = merged map) → pending permission (409 permission-pending) → main input target (409 input-target-not-main). Run: assumeBusy → relink + one reload → queued; else baseline reload, busy fallback after 15 s → queued, relink with the same selection, second reload, compare S1−S0 with the mounted-skill delta → hot or sent. Deliver with deliverAgentMessage(conv.tmuxSession, '/reload-plugins', 'skill-reload', 'tmux') (forced tmux method so the text is pasted into the pane, never routed through Channels; on Herdr the herdr prompt path types it); never handleConversationMessage. hotApplyPrecheck returns { kind: ready, selection, mcp, mounted } on success and hotApplyRun takes that object, so one resolution feeds both the D-8 check and the mount. Build the mount before the baseline reload; in the busy fallback, after relinking read the pane once more and send a second reload if a new Reloaded: line appeared after the timeout. Default readProcessArgs lazily imports conversation-runtime.js.

items.title: hasPluginDirArg returns true for args containing `--plugin-dir <link>` followed by a space or the end, and false for a sibling session's link (conv-ab vs conv-a) or a missing flag

launchWiredChange returns the pack id when a deft skill, a gstack-runtime pack or a pack listed in mcp[] changes against the mounted skill set, and returns [] for a plain pack or an unchanged deft pack

Given an idle conversation (fake timers), hotApplyRun delivers /reload-plugins, then relinks, then delivers again in that order, and returns hot when S1−S0 equals the skill delta and sent when it differs

Given no new Reloaded: line within 15 s of the baseline reload, hotApplyRun relinks and returns queued, sending a second reload only when a new line appears on the read after the relink; given assumeBusy, it relinks, sends one reload, reads no pane and returns queued

hotApplyPrecheck returns not-hot/no-plugin-dir when ps args lack the link, not-hot/launch-wired for a D-8 change, and refused 409 with code permission-pending or input-target-not-main for the two guards
The default deliver dependency sends through deliverAgentMessage(session, '/reload-plugins', 'skill-reload', 'tmux') and never calls handleConversationMessage
Conversation skill apply service: validate, merge into the chain head, choose the outcome

metadata.parallelSafeReason: New module plus one setter in src/lib/overdeck/conversations.ts, which no other item edits; it runs after hot-apply, whose exports it calls.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-4 with D-1, D-6, D-10 to D-13. Add setConversationSkillOverrides to conversations.ts beside setConversationModel. New module exporting SkillApplyOutcome ('hot'|'sent'|'queued'|'needs-restart'|'restarted'|'next-launch'), parseSkillApplyBody (groups key → 400 'Pack groups are not supported yet'), applyConversationSkills(name, request, { self }, deps) and readConversationSkills. Steps: per-name in-flight lock (409 apply-in-progress) → empty lists 400 → self+restart 400 → row → chain head (resolveClearChainHead) → conversationWriteRefusal/shutdownDrainingRefusal → harness gate 409 → expand with resolveConversationSkillFlags and validate off (400, nothing stored) → isAlive (confirmed dead → write, next-launch; indeterminate → write, needs-restart) → native or codex → write, needs-restart or resume apply → claude: hotApplyPrecheck with conversationLayer=merged (refused → 409, nothing stored; not-hot → write, needs-restart/restarted) → write → hotApplyRun(assumeBusy = self). Resume apply = lazy import of conversation-runtime.js: stopConversationRuntime then handleConversationResume(name, { sendResumeContract: false }, { resolveSessionFile, resumeCause: 'system' }); non-200 → 502.

items.title: Given a confirmed-stopped conversation the service returns next-launch; a running Codex one returns needs-restart; Codex with restart:true returns restarted; a native skill on Claude returns needs-restart; the hot path returns the hotApplyRun outcome
Merging preserves unrelated map entries, `off` persists false, and `added` lists only ids whose value changed
A Pi conversation returns 409, an unknown pack returns 400, empty lists return 400, a precheck refusal returns 409, and in each case the stored skill map is unchanged
Given a superseded /clear row, applyConversationSkills persists the map on the chain head's row, not the named row

With self:true, restart:true returns 400 and a hot apply passes assumeBusy:true; a second call on the same chain head's tmuxSession while one is in flight returns 409 apply-in-progress; runtime-indeterminate with restart:true returns needs-restart without resuming
